press-mbusa-e-class-2017-24c0e5da.extract:
{"pdf_sha256": "24c0e5da6b041e5afc6c4d75383f9b9c1dc129cd872d629d9646d105c526a88a", "url": "https://media.mbusa.com/news/quick-reference-guide-20172018-e-class-wagon", "pages": {"1": "2017/2018 E-Class Wagon Quick Reference Guide
February 1, 2017
Models & MSRP
Mercedes-Benz E400 4MATIC Wagon (2017) – $TBA, arriving in U.S. dealers by March, 2017 Mercedes-AMG E63 S Wagon (2018) - $TBA, arriving in U.S. dealers by fall 2017
E400 4MATIC Wagon Standard Highlights:
3.0L V6 biturbo engine delivering an output of 329 hp and 354 lb-ft of torque
9G-TRONIC9-speedtransmission
4MATIC all-wheel drive system
Three rows of seats—seating for up to 7, including standard foldable rear-facing seats in the cargo area
40:20:40 split-folding rear seats (same as the all-new E-Class sedan)
Available in both Luxury (classic bumpers/styling with hood ornament) and Sport models (sportier bumpers and grille treatment)
E63 S Wagon Standard Highlights:
AMG 4.0L V8 biturbo engine (603 hp / 627 lb-ft)
0-60 mph: 3.4 seconds, top speed 180 mph (electronically limited)
AMG Performance 4MATIC+ all-wheel drive system
AMG SPEED SHIFT MCT nine-speed sport transmission
Drift Mode, equipped as standard, allows the E63 S Wagon to become 100% rear-wheel-drive
E-Class Technical Highlights:
PRE-SAFE® Sound: omits a short interference signal if an imminent collision is detected, triggering a protective reflex in the human ear referred to as the "stapedius reflex," which can help reduce hearing loss in the event of an accident
DRIVE PILOT , including:
Distance Pilot DISTRONIC® is now able to follow a vehicle in front at a pre-selected distance at speeds up to 130 mph
Steering Pilot functions at speeds up to 130 mph in ideal conditions and can now actively intervene even if road lines are unclear or non-existent at speeds up to 81 mph
Active Lane-change Assist : radar-and-camera-based system that aids the driver when changing lanes—when overtaking, for example. When a turn is indicated for at least two seconds, Active Lane-change Assist will aid with steering into the adjacent lane if it detects the lane is empty
Active Brake Assist w/ Cross-Traffic Function
Evasive Steering Assist: when a driver deliberately or instinctively performs an evasive maneuver, this system assists by adding calculated steering torque to aid in steering wheel movement
Car-to-X communication : Available from 2016, the world's first fully-integral Car-to-X solution goinginto series production; the E-Class simultaneously acts as a receiver and transmitter, conveying warning messages and evaluating driving conditions, effectively allowing the driver to "see around corners" and "through obstacles"
PRE-SAFE® Impulse Side : if a lateral collision is detected, the system preventatively moves the driver or front passenger up to 2.75-inches away from the impact zone to the side by rapidly inflating the seat's side bolster, reducing the load on the occupant during an accident
Touch Control Buttons : touch-sensitive controls on the steering wheel for instrument cluster and infotainment system control, similar to a smart-phone interface, which respond to vertical and horizontal swiping movements
Segment-leading, next-gen, high-resolution 12.3"i nfotainment display with advanced, simplified user interface
AIR BODY CONTROL: Available multi-chamber air suspension at all corners
Ambient lighting in 64 colors thanks to energy-saving LED technology
Warmth and Comfort Package : (segment exclusive)offers heated door armrests, center console, steering wheel and rapidly-heating front seats
Model Positioning:
The E-Class Wagon debuted in the 1970's and has one of the most affluent customer profiles of any vehicle in the Mercedes-Benz portfolio. Top U.S. E-Class Wagon markets (including the current AMG E63 model) are California, New York/New Jersey, Florida, and Massachusetts.
Like the E63 S Sedan, the E63 S Wagon offers a hand-crafted AMG 4.0-liter V8 biturbo engine with an output of up to 603 hp and the fully variable AMG Performance 4MATIC+ all-wheel drive deliver outstanding driving dynamics. Acceleration from 0 to 60 mph in 3.4 seconds sets a new record in this class.

press-mbusa-e-class-2017-d92392d1.extract:
{"pdf_sha256": "d92392d1d1a023ebe29248ab2310ede47797f539e4fa360049933e38cb7c02e2", "url": "https://media.mbusa.com/news/2017-e-class-quick-reference-guide-1", "pages": {"1": "2017-2018 E-Class Quick Reference Guide
September 23, 2016
Models & MSRP
E300 RWD Sedan (2017) - $52,150, in dealers now
E300 4MATIC Sedan (2017) - $54,650, in dealers now
Mercedes-AMG E43 Sedan (2017) – $72,400, in dealers now
Mercedes-AMG E63 S Sedan (2018) - $TBA, arriving in U.S. dealers summer 2017
*Above prices exclude $925 destination and delivery
E300 Sedan Highlights:
Efficient and powerful turbocharged 2.0L inline-4 turbocharged engine with 241 hp and 273 lb-ft
9G-TRONIC 9-speed automatic transmission
Suspension with selective damping system / lowered suspension with selective damping system, or optional AIR BODY CONTROL multi-chamber air suspension
Embodies the Mercedes-Benz "Sensual Purity" design philosophy both inside and out
Available NFC (Near Field Communication) charging for compatible smartphones
AMG E43 Sedan Highlights:
AMG-enhanced 3.0L V6 biturbo engine producing 396 hp and 384 lb-ft of torque
AMG-enhanced 9G-TRONIC 9-speed transmission
AMG Performance 4MATIC® four-wheel drive system features rear-biased torque distribution with a front/rear axle split of 31 to 69 percent
AMG Sport Suspension based on AIR BODY CONTROL
Available dual 12.3" high-resolution displays, including instrument cluster display
Standard 19" wheels
AMG E63 S Sedan Highlights:
AMG 4.0L V8 biturbo engine (603 hp / 627 lb-ft)
0-60 mph: 3.3 seconds, top speed 186 mph (electronically limited)
AMG SPEEDSHIFT MCT nine-speed sport transmission
AMG Performance 4MATIC+ all-wheel drive system
Completely re-engineered AMG sport suspension
Drift Mode, equipped as standard, allows the E63 S Sedan to become 100% rear-wheel-drive
E-Class Technical Highlights:
PRE-SAFE® Sound: omits a short interference signal if an imminent collision is detected, triggering a protective reflex in the human ear referred to as the “stapedius reflex,” which can help reduce hearing loss in the event of an accident
DRIVE PILOT , including:
Distance Pilot DISTRONIC® is now able to follow a vehicle in front at a pre-selected distance at speeds up to 130 mph
Steering Pilot functions at speeds up to 130 mph in ideal conditions and can now actively intervene even if road lines are unclear or non-existent at speeds up to 81 mph
Active Lane-change Assist: radar-and-camera-based system that aids the driver when changing lanes—when overtaking, for example. When a turn is indicated for at least two seconds, Active Lane-change Assist will aid with steering into the adjacent lane if it detects the lane is empty
Active Brake Assist w/ Cross-Traffic Function
Evasive Steering Assist: when a driver deliberately or instinctively performs an evasive maneuver, this system assists by adding calculated steering torque to aid in steering wheel movement
Car-to-X communication: the world’s first fully-integral Car-to-X solution going into series production; the E-Class simultaneously acts as a receiver and transmitter, conveying warning messages and evaluating driving conditions, effectively allowing the driver to “see around corners” and “through obstacles”
PRE-SAFE® Impulse Side: : if a lateral collision is detected, the system preventatively moves the driver or front passenger up to 2.75-inches away from the impact zone to the side by rapidly inflating the seat’s side bolster, reducing the load on the occupant during an accident
Touch Control Buttons: touch-sensitive controls on the steering wheel for instrument cluster and infotainment system control, similar to a smart-phone interface, which respond to vertical and horizontal swiping movements
Segment-leading, next-gen, high-resolution 12.3” infotainment display with advanced, simplified user interface
AIR BODY CONTROL: Available multi-chamber air suspension at all corners
Ambient lighting in 64 colors thanks to energy-saving LED technology
Warmth and Comfort Package: (segment exclusive) offers heated door armrests, center console, steering wheel and rapidly-heating front seats
Model Positioning:
The all-new 2017 E-Class Sedan and Wagon are the most advanced vehicles the Mercedes-Benz product portfolio. The 10th generation (sedan version) of one of the world's most successful vehicles launches with several world-premiere technologies, an all-new emotional design both inside and out, and top levels of comfort, luxury and safety.
The Mercedes-AMG E43 Sedan, the first high-performance variant of the E-Class developed by Mercedes- AMG, boasts an AMG-enhanced 3.0L V6 biturbo engine, dynamic drive qualities and top-levels of technology.
The Mercedes-AMG E63 S Sedan is the most powerful E-Class variant of all time. The versatile AMG 4.0L V8 biturbo engine in the E63 S Sedan takes peak performance to a new level at 603 hp. A sprint from zero to 60 mph takes only 3.3 seconds, and this dynamic acceleration only ends at the governed top speed of 186 mph.

{"pdf_sha256": "85d40ea3c092919a0da37002de4ea474048169f195a9906b838578d638c0a9d4", "url": "https://media.mbusa.com/news/2018-e-class-wagon-quick-reference-guide", "pages": {"1": "2018 E-Class Wagon Quick Reference Guide
August 4, 2017
Models & MSRP
Mercedes-Benz E 400 4MATIC Wagon $63,050
Mercedes-AMG E 63 S Wagon $106,950
*Above prices exclude $995 destination and delivery
Model Year Changes (E 400)
Rearview camera now standard
New trims: Natural Grain Black Ash Wood and Natural Grain Brown Ash Wood with matching center consoles
New Premium Package structure
Night Package
Soft-close doors
Illuminated door sills with "Mercedes-Benz" lettering
Rear Seat Entertainment and Comfort Adapter
3-Zone climate control
Active Multicontour Seats w/ massage function
E 400 4MATIC Wagon Standard Highlights
3.0L V6 biturbo engine delivering an output of 329 hp and 354 lb-ft of torque
9G-TRONIC 9-speed transmission
4MATIC all-wheel drive system
Three rows of seats—seating for up to 7, including standard foldable rear-facing seats in the cargo area
40:20:40 split-folding rear seats (same as the all-new E-Class sedan)
Available in both Luxury (classic bumpers/styling with hood ornament) and Sport models (sportier bumpers and grille treatment)
E 63 S Wagon Standard Highlights
AMG 4.0L V8 biturbo engine (603 hp / 627 lb-ft)
0-60 mph: 3.4 seconds, top speed 180 mph (electronically limited)
AMG Performance 4MATIC+ all-wheel drive system
AMG SPEEDSHIFT MCT nine-speed sport transmission
Drift Mode, equipped as standard, allows the E63 S Wagon to become 100% rear-wheel-drive
E-Class Technical Highlights
PRE-SAFE ® Sound: omits a short interference signal if an imminent collision is detected, triggering a protective reflex in the human ear referred to as the "stapedius reflex," which can help reduce hearing loss in the event of an accident
Active Distance Assist DISTRONIC ® is able to follow a vehicle at a pre-selected distance at a wide range of speeds
Active Steering Assist can now actively intervene even if road lines are unclear or non- existent
Active Lane Change Assist: radar-and-camera-based system that aids the driver when changing lanes, for example, when overtaking. When a turn is indicated for at least two seconds, Active Lane Change Assist will aid with steering into the adjacent lane if it detects the lane is empty
Active Brake Assist w/ Cross-Traffic Function
Evasive Steering Assist: when a driver deliberately or instinctively performs an evasive maneuver, this system assists by adding calculated steering torque to aid in steering wheel movement
Car-to-X communication: Available from 2016, the world’s first fully-integral Car-to-X solution going into series production; the E-Class simultaneously acts as a receiver and transmitter, conveying warning messages and evaluating driving conditions, effectively allowing the driver to "see around corners" and "through obstacles"
PRE-SAFE ® Impulse Side: if a lateral collision is detected, the system preventatively moves the driver or front passenger up to 2.75-inches away from the impact zone to the side by rapidly inflating the seat’s side bolster, reducing the load on the occupant during an accident
Touch Control Buttons: touch-sensitive controls on the steering wheel for instrument cluster and infotainment system control, similar to a smart-phone interface, which respond to vertical and horizontal swiping movements
Segment-leading, next-gen, high-resolution 12.3" infotainment display with advanced, simplified user interface
AIR BODY CONTROL: Available multi-chamber air suspension at all corners
Ambient lighting in 64 colors thanks to energy-saving LED technology
Warmth and Comfort Package: (segment exclusive) offers heated door armrests, center console, steering wheel and rapidly-heating front seats
Model Positioning
The E-Class Wagon debuted in the 1970’s and has one of the most affluent customer profiles of any vehicle in the Mercedes-Benz portfolio. Top U.S. E-Class Wagon markets (including the current AMG E 63 model) are California, New York/New Jersey, Florida, and Massachusetts.
Like the E 63 S Sedan, the E 63 S Wagon offers a hand-crafted AMG 4.0-liter V8 biturbo engine with an output of up to 603 hp and the fully variable AMG Performance 4MATIC+ all-wheel drive deliver outstanding driving dynamics. Acceleration from 0 to 60 mph in 3.4 seconds sets a new record in this class.

E-Class Technical Highlights
Active Distance Assist DISTRONIC ® is an adaptive Cruise Control system that is able to follow a vehicle in front at a pre-selected distance

Active Emergency Stop Assist brakes the vehicle to a standstill in its lane if it detects that the driver is no longer actively driving the vehicle while driving with Active Distance Assist DISTRONIC and Active Steering Assist engaged. Active Lane Change Assist is a radar-and-camera-based system that aids the driver when changing lanes. When a turn is indicated, this feature will aid with steering into the adjacent lane if it detects the lane is empty
Active Speed Limit Assist can adapt vehicle speed to identified speed limits and can now adjust preemptively when speed limits are going to change
Route-Based Speed Adaptation can reduce the vehicle's speed in anticipatory mode by referencing the COMAND map data ahead of bends, junctions, roundabouts, toll booths and exit roads

Active Blind Spot Assist is able to provide the driver with a visual alert, plus an audible alarm when a turn indicator is actuated, to warn of a side collision with another vehicle, or even bicycles, for example. At higher speeds, one-sided, automatic braking can additionally be applied to help avoid a side collision.
Active Lane Keeping Assist is able to warn the driver by means of vibrations of the steering wheel when the vehicle is unintentionally drifting out of its lane. If the vehicle passes over a solid line, this system can pull the vehicle back into lane by applying the brakes on one side. In the case of crossing a broken line, such intervention takes place only when there is a danger of collision with a vehicle in the next lane (including danger from oncoming traffic).

Car-to-X communication: the world's first fully-integral Car-to-X solution going into series production; the E-Class simultaneously acts as a receiver and transmitter, conveying warning messages and evaluating driving conditions, effectively allowing the driver to "see around corners" and "through obstacles"
PRE-SAFE ® Impulse Side: if a lateral collision is detected, the system preventatively moves the driver or front passenger up to 2.75-inches away from the impact zone to the side by rapidly inflating the seat's side bolster, reducing the load on the occupant during an accident
Touch Control Buttons: touch-sensitive controls on the steering wheel for instrument cluster and infotainment system control, similar to a smart-phone interface, which respond to vertical and horizontal swiping movements

AMG E 53 Optional Feature Highlights (includes features listed above)
AMG Night Package

AMG Track Pace App
AMG Performance Exhaust System
E-Class Technical Highlights
48-Volt onboard electrical system technology with EQ boost (Integrated Starter Generator)
The AMG-enhanced 3.0-Liter inline 6 cylinder engine found in the AMG E 53 Cabriolet is supplemented with a powerful and efficient integrated starter generator and a powerful auxiliary compressor. This integrated electric motor system, known as EQ boost, assists the combustion engine by adding up to 21 hp for short periods. EQ boost also assists when accelerating, makes driving without the combustion engine possible ("sailing") and supplies the battery with power by means of high-efficiency recuperation. By doing so it makes fuel savings possible that were previously the exclusive domain of high-voltage hybrid technology.
AIRCAP® and AIRSCARF®
Active Distance Assist DISTRONIC ® is an adaptive Cruise Control system that is able to follow a vehicle in front at a pre-selected distance
Active Steering Assist provides steering input and can actively intervene even if road lines are unclear or non-existent at certain speeds; can now function in curves with a tighter radius
Active Emergency Stop Assist brakes the vehicle to a standstill in its lane if it detects that the driver is no longer actively driving the vehicle while driving
Active Lane Change Assist is a radar-and-camera-based system that aids the driver when changing lanes
Active Speed Limit Assist can adapt vehicle speed to identified speed limits and can now adjust preemptively when speed limits are going to change
Route-Based Speed Adaptation can reduce the vehicle's speed in anticipatory mode by referencing the COMAND map data ahead of bends, junctions, roundabouts, toll booths and exit roads
Active Brake Assist with Cross-Traffic Function is able to help the driver avoid impending collisions with vehicles ahead, stationary or crossing vehicles and pedestrians if the driver fails to take any action to defuse the dangerous situation
Evasive Steering Assist assists the driver by adding calculated steering torque to aid in steering wheel movement when a driver deliberately or instinctively performs an evasive maneuver around a pedestrian
Active Blind Spot Assist is able to provide the driver with a visual alert, plus an audible alarm when a turn indicator is actuated, to warn of a side collision with another vehicle, or even bicycles, for example. At higher speeds, one-sided, automatic braking can additionally be applied to help avoid a side collision.
Active Lane Keeping Assist is able to warn the driver by means of vibrations of the steering wheel when the vehicle is unintentionally drifting out of its lane. If the vehicle passes over a solid line, this system can pull the vehicle back into lane by applying the brakes on one side.
PRE-SAFE ® Sound: omits a short interference signal if an imminent collision is detected, triggering
a protective reflex in the human ear referred to as the "stapedius reflex," which can help reduce hearing loss in the event of an accident
Car-to-X communication: the world's first fully-integral Car-to-X solution going into series production; the E-Class simultaneously acts as a receiver and transmitter, conveying warning messages and evaluating driving conditions, effectively allowing the driver to "see around corners" and "through obstacles"
Touch Control Buttons: touch-sensitive controls on the steering wheel for instrument cluster and infotainment system control, similar to a smart-phone interface, which respond to vertical and horizontal swiping movements
Model Positioning
Following the introduction of the world's most intelligent sedan, wagon and coupe, the E-Class Cabriolet—available for the first time with 4MATIC all-wheel drive--now completes the E-Class family. With expressive proportions, clear and sensual design and generous rear seat accommodations, the new E-Class Cabriolet ensures all-season open-top driving and comfort for four. The Mercedes-AMG E-Class Cabrio is also among the first vehicles in the Mercedes-Benz and Mercedes-AMG lineup with 48-volt technology that offers increased efficiency and comfort.

E-Class Technical Highlights
Active Distance Assist DISTRONIC® is an adaptive Cruise Control system that is able to follow a vehicle in front at a pre-selected distance
Active Steering Assist provides steering input and can actively intervene even if road lines are unclear or non-existent at certain speeds; can now function in curves with a tighter radius
Active Emergency Stop Assist brakes the vehicle to a standstill in its lane if it detects that the driver is no longer actively driving the vehicle while driving
Active Lane Change Assist is a radar-and-camera-based system that aids the driver when changing lanes
Active Speed Limit Assist can adapt vehicle speed to identified speed limits and can now adjust preemptively when speed limits are going to change
Route-Based Speed Adaptation can reduce the vehicle's speed in anticipatory mode by referencing the COMAND map data ahead of bends, junctions, roundabouts, toll booths and exit roads
Active Brake Assist with Cross-Traffic Function is able to help the driver avoid impending collisions with vehicles ahead, stationary or crossing vehicles and pedestrians if the driver fails to take any action to defuse the dangerous situation
Evasive Steering Assist assists the driver by adding calculated steering torque to aid in steering wheel movement when a driver deliberately or instinctively performs an evasive maneuver around a pedestrian
Active Blind Spot Assist is able to provide the driver with a visual alert, plus an audible alarm when a turn indicator is actuated, to warn of a side collision with another vehicle, or even bicycles, for example. At higher speeds, one-sided, automatic braking can additionally be applied to help avoid a side collision.
Active Lane Keeping Assist is able to warn the driver by means of vibrations of the steering wheel when the vehicle is unintentionally drifting out of its lane. If the vehicle passes over a solid line, this system can pull the vehicle back into lane by applying the brakes on one side.
PRE-SAFE® Sound: omits a short interference signal if an imminent collision is detected, triggering a protective reflex in the human ear referred to as the "stapedius reflex," which can help reduce hearing loss in the event of an accident
Car-to-X communication: the world's first fully-integral Car-to-X solution going into series production; the E-Class simultaneously acts as a receiver and transmitter, conveying warning messages and evaluating driving conditions, effectively allowing the driver to "see around corners" and "through obstacles"
Touch Control Buttons: touch-sensitive controls on the steering wheel for instrument cluster and infotainment system control, similar to a smart-phone interface, which respond to vertical and horizontal swiping movements
Model Positioning
The E-Class Wagon debuted in the 1970's and has one of the most affluent customer profiles of any vehicle in the Mercedes-Benz portfolio. Top U.S. E-Class Wagon markets (including the current AMG E 63 model) are California, New York/New Jersey, Florida, and Massachusetts.
Like the E 63 S Sedan, the E 63 S Wagon offers a hand-crafted AMG 4.0-liter V8 biturbo engine with an output of up to 603 hp and the fully variable AMG Performance 4MATIC+ all-wheel drive deliver outstanding driving dynamics. Acceleration from 0 to 60 mph in 3.4 seconds sets a new record in this class.

E-Class Technical Highlights
The available active safety systems on the E-Class include:
Active Distance Assist DISTRONIC ® is an adaptive Cruise Control system that is able to follow a vehicle in front at a pre-selected distance
Active Steering Assist provides steering input and can actively intervene even if road lines are unclear or non-existent at certain speeds; can now function in curves with a tighter radius
Active Emergency Stop Assist brakes the vehicle to a standstill in its lane if it detects that the driver is no longer actively driving the vehicle while driving with Active Distance Assist DISTRONIC and Active Steering Assist engaged. Can now unlock the doors when the vehicle is stationary to allow first aid responders immediate access to the vehicle's interior.
Active Lane Change Assist is a radar-and-camera-based system that aids the driver when changing lanes. When a turn is indicated, this feature will aid with steering into the adjacent lane if it detects the lane is empty.
Active Speed Limit Assist can adapt vehicle speed to identified speed limits and can now adjust preemptively when speed limits are going to change
Route-Based Speed Adaptation can reduce the vehicle's speed in anticipatory mode by referencing the COMAND map data ahead of bends, junctions, roundabouts, toll booths and exit roads
Active Brake Assist with Cross-Traffic Function is able to help the driver avoid impending collisions with vehicles ahead, stationary or crossing vehicles and pedestrians if the driver fails to take any action to defuse the dangerous situation
Evasive Steering Assist assists the driver by adding calculated steering torque to aid in steering wheel movement when a driver deliberately or instinctively performs an evasive maneuver around a pedestrian
Active Blind Spot Assist is able to provide the driver with a visual alert, plus an audible alarm when a turn indicator is actuated, to warn of a side collision with another vehicle, or even bicycles, for example. At higher speeds, one-sided, automatic braking can additionally be applied to help avoid a side collision.
Active Lane Keeping Assist is able to warn the driver by means of vibrations of the steering wheel when the vehicle is unintentionally drifting out of its lane. If the vehicle passes over a solid line, this system can pull the vehicle back into lane by applying the brakes on one side. In the case of crossing a broken line, such intervention takes place only when there is a danger of collision with a vehicle in the next lane (including danger from oncoming traffic).
PRE-SAFE ® Sound: omits a short interference signal if an imminent collision is detected, triggering a protective reflex in the human ear referred to as the "stapedius reflex," which can help reduce hearing loss in the event of an accident
Car-to-X communication: the world's first fully-integral Car-to-X solution going into series production; the E-Class simultaneously acts as a receiver and transmitter, conveying warning messages and evaluating driving conditions, effectively allowing the driver to "see around corners" and “through obstacles"
PRE-SAFE ® Impulse Side: if a lateral collision is detected, the system preventatively moves the driver or front passenger up to 2.75-inches away from the impact zone to the side by rapidly inflating the seat's side bolster, reducing the load on the occupant during an accident
Touch Control Buttons: touch-sensitive controls on the steering wheel for instrument cluster and infotainment system control, similar to a smart-phone interface, which respond to vertical and horizontal swiping movements
Model Positioning
The mid-size luxury E-Class Sedan model line offers a wide range of models that boast top levels of comfort, luxury and safety.
The new Mercedes-AMG E 53 Sedan with an AMG-enhanced 3.0L I6 Turbo Engine with EQ Boost and electric auxiliary compressor is characterized by top performance and intelligent electrification.
The Mercedes-AMG E 63 S Sedan is the most powerful E-Class variant of all time. The versatile AMG 4.0L V8 biturbo engine in the E 63 S Sedan takes peak performance to a new level at 603 hp. A sprint from zero to 60 mph takes only 3.3 seconds, and this dynamic acceleration only ends at the governed top speed of 186 mph.

E-Class Technical Highlights
48-Volt onboard electrical system technology with EQ boost starter alternator (AMG E 53)
The AMG-enhanced 3.0-Liter inline 6 cylinder engine found in the E 53 Coupe is supplemented with a powerful and efficient starter alternator system. This integrated electric motor system, known as EQ boost, assists the combustion engine by adding 21 hp and 184 lb-ft of torque. EQ boost also assists when accelerating, makes driving without the combustion engine possible ("sailing") and supplies the battery with power by means of high-efficiency recuperation. By doing so it makes fuel savings possible that were previously the exclusive domain of high-voltage hybrid technology. The new in-line six-cylinder engine delivers the performance of an eight-cylinder engine with significantly lower consumption.
With the optional Driver Assistance Package, the active safety systems include:
Active Distance Assist DISTRONIC ® is an adaptive Cruise Control system that is able to follow a vehicle in front at a pre-selected distance
Active Steering Assist provides steering input and can actively intervene even if road lines are unclear or non- existent at certain speeds; can now function in curves with a tighter radius
Active Emergency Stop Assist brakes the vehicle to a standstill in its lane if it detects that the driver is no longer actively driving the vehicle while driving
Active Lane Change Assist is a radar-and-camera-based system that aids the driver when changing lanes
Active Speed Limit Assist can adapt vehicle speed to identified speed limits and can now adjust preemptively when speed limits are going to change
Route-Based Speed Adaptation can reduce the vehicle's speed in anticipatory mode by referencing the COMAND map data ahead of bends, junctions, roundabouts, toll booths and exit roads
Active Brake Assist with Cross-Traffic Function is able to help the driver avoid impending collisions with vehicles ahead, stationary or crossing vehicles and pedestrians if the driver fails to take any action to defuse the dangerous situation
Evasive Steering Assist assists the driver by adding calculated steering torque to aid in steering wheel movement when a driver deliberately or instinctively performs an evasive maneuver around a pedestrian
Active Blind Spot Assist is able to provide the driver with a visual alert, plus an audible alarm when a turn indicator is actuated, to warn of a side collision with another vehicle, or even bicycles, for example. At higher speeds, one-sided, automatic braking can additionally be applied to help avoid a side collision.
Active Lane Keeping Assist is able to warn the driver by means of vibrations of the steering wheel when the vehicle is unintentionally drifting out of its lane. If the vehicle passes over a solid line, this system can pull the vehicle back into lane by applying the brakes on one side.
PRE-SAFE ® Sound: omits a short interference signal if an imminent collision is detected, triggering a protective reflex in the human ear referred to as the "stapedius reflex," which can help reduce hearing loss in the event of an accident
Car-to-X communication: the world's first fully-integral Car-to-X solution going into series production; the E- Class simultaneously acts as a receiver and transmitter, conveying warning messages and evaluating driving conditions, effectively allowing the driver to "see around corners" and "through obstacles"
Touch Control Buttons: touch-sensitive controls on the steering wheel for instrument cluster and infotainment system control, similar to a smart-phone interface, which respond to vertical and horizontal swiping movements
Model Positioning
With expressive proportions, clear and sensual design and long-distance comfort for four people, the new E-Class Coupe combines the beauty and classic virtues of a grand tourer with state-of-the-art technology. The Mercedes- AMG E-Class Coupe is also among the first vehicles in the Mercedes-Benz and Mercedes-AMG lineup with 48-volt technology that offers increased efficiency and comfort.

{"pdf_sha256": "1907eea4b5a361d1fceb4670ff8faed7cbed14f929aa4885b2053d5597c2c48f", "url": "https://media.mbusa.com/news/2021-e-class-cabriolet-quick-reference-guide", "pages": {"1": "2021 E-Class Cabriolet Quick Reference Guide
May 26, 2020

What’s New for E 450/ E450 4MATIC Cabriolet
New 3.0L Inline-6 turbocharged engine with EQ Boost
Next level of Intelligent Drive driver assistance systems available

Progressive and modern interior design with widescreen dual display with 12.3” Digital Instrument Cluster and 12.3” multimedia display with touchscreen
New-generation steering wheel with capacitive Touch Control Buttons and two-zone sensor mat located on the rim of the steering wheel detects whether the driver’s hands are grasping the wheel. New capabilities ease the operation as the driver no longer needs to make an active steering movement to signal to the assistance systems that they are in control

Three new trim options: Carbon-Grain Aluminum, Longitudinal Grain Aluminum and Natural Grain Gray Ash Wood
MBUX Interior assistant, Augmented Video for Navigation and Dashcam
E-Class Cabriolet Technical Feature Highlights
AIRCAP® and AIRSCARF® : open-air comfort is possible in all seasons thanks to the standard AIRCAP® and the AIRSCARF® neck-level heating systems, which make the fresh air much more enjoyable even at low outside temperatures. The AIRCAP system was developed specifically for Mercedes-Benz cabriolets and consists of an electric wind deflector inconspicuously integrated into the roof frame and an electric wind blocker behind the rear seats that reduces the interior turbulence and noise. At the press of a button, AIRSCARF neck-level heating circulates warm air around the neck area of the driver and/or front passenger.
Mercedes-Benz User Experience (MBUX): A revolutionary multimedia system featuring innovative technology based on Artificial Intelligence and an intuitive operating system. MBUX is pioneering a new level of in-car experience. The system can be operated by a new generation of Voice Control, the center touchscreen, touchpad, and/or by the new capacitive Touch Control Buttons on the steering wheel. The system has learning capabilities and intelligent Voice Control with Natural Language Understanding and a verbal cue of “Hey Mercedes.”
with Augmented Video Navigation (available), when the navigation function is active, a video image of the surroundings is enhanced with arrows or house numbers automatically superimposed directly onto the image in the media display.
Active Parking Assist with PARKTRONIC and 360° surround view camera make it possible to enter and leave parallel and end-on parking spaces or garages automatically (standard).
Driver Assistance Systems: The E-Class receives the latest in driver assistance technology including intelligent hands-off detection. The available Driver Assistance Package includes:
Active Distance Assist DISTRONIC® is an adaptive cruise control system that is able to automatically adjust your set speed for traffic ahead
with Route-Based Speed Adaptation, the vehicle is able to reduce the speed in anticipatory mode by referencing map data ahead of curves, junctions, roundabouts, toll booths and exit roads.
and LiveTraffic and End-of-Traffic-Jam Assist, the vehicle can recognize and respond to traffic jams and slow-moving traffic even before the driver becomes aware of them. Once traffic is detected, the speed is reduced to approx. 60 mph as a precaution unless the driver decides otherwise.
Active Stop-and-Go Assist , is able to keep the vehicle within the lane and maintain a safe distance with a high level of availability at speeds up to 35 mph. With the extended restart function, the vehicle can restart automatically up to one minute after coming to a stop.
Active Steering Assist generates steering torque which helps the driver to stay in the center of the lane on straight roads and slight bends, taking its guidance from vehicles ahead and lane markings
with Active Emergency Stop Assist , which brakes the vehicle to a stop in a controlled manner when the system recognizes that the driver is distracted for a longer period or cannot intervene in vehicle control
and Active Lane Change Assist , which assists the driver in a convenient and cooperative manner when making lane changes.
Active Brake Assist with Cross-Traffic Function is able to help the driver avoid impending collisions with vehicles ahead or when turning off across the oncoming lane, the system will also assist with stationary or crossing vehicles and pedestrians, if the driver fails to take action quickly enough.
Active Speed Limit Assist with Traffic Sign Assist utilizes map data and information from Traffic Sign Assist to automatically adapt the vehicle's speed.
Active Blind Spot Assist is able to provide the driver with a visual alert, plus an audible alarm when a turn indicator is activated, to warn the driver if another vehicle is detected in the blind spot area. It can also help avoid a collision by single-sided braking if a lane change is still attempted with an obstacle in the blind spot.
with Exit Warning offers enhanced protection when getting out of the car, a visual warning for passengers displayed in the exterior mirror if a car or bicycle is driving past the vehicle. If the driver tries to open the door, an additional audible warning sound and ambient door lighting will start to flash red.
Active Lane Keeping Assist is able to warn the driver by means of vibrations of the steering wheel when the vehicle is unintentionally drifting out of its lane. If the vehicle passes over a solid line, or a dashed line when opposing traffic is detected, this system can pull the vehicle back into its lane by applying the brakes on one side.
PRE-SAFE® PLUS with PRE-SAFE® Sound activates the PRE-SAFE safety measures when a collision from behind is imminent as well as applying the brakes when the vehicle is at a standstill in order to prevent subsequent accidents. PRE-SAFE® Sound omits a short interference signal if an imminent collision is detected, triggering a protective reflex in the human ear referred to as the “stapedius reflex,” which can help reduce hearing loss in the event of an accident.
Model Positioning
With expressive proportions, clear and sensual design and generous rear seat accommodations, the E- Class Cabriolet ensures all-season open-top driving and comfort for four. With its recent redesign, the E-Class continues to set the benchmark for intelligence within the Mercedes-Benz lineup through top levels of technology, luxury and safety.

E-Class Technical Feature Highlights
Mercedes-Benz User Experience (MBUX): A revolutionary multimedia system featuring innovative technology based on Artificial Intelligence and an intuitive operating system. MBUX is pioneering a new level of in-car experience. The system can be operated by a new generation of Voice Control, the center touchscreen, a new Touchpad, and/or by the Touch Control Buttons on the steering wheel. The system has learning capabilities and intelligent Voice Control with Natural Language Understanding and a verbal cue of “Hey Mercedes.”
Augmented Video Navigation (available), when the navigation function is active, a video image of the surroundings is enhanced with arrows or house numbers automatically superimposed directly onto the image in the media display.
MBUX Interior Assistant (available), allows intuitive, natural operation of various comfort and MBUX functions through movement recognition.
Driver Assistance Systems: The E-Class receives the latest in driver assistance technology including intelligent hands-off detection. The available Driver Assistance Package includes:
Active Distance Assist DISTRONIC® is an adaptive cruise control system that is able to automatically adjust your set speed for traffic ahead
with Route-Based Speed Adaptation, the vehicle is able to reduce the speed in anticipatory mode by referencing map data ahead of curves, junctions, roundabouts, toll booths and exit roads.
and LiveTraffic and End-of-Traffic-Jam Assist, the vehicle can recognize and respond to traffic jams and slow-moving traffic even before the driver becomes aware of them. Once traffic is detected, the speed is reduced to approx. 60 mph as a precaution unless the driver decides otherwise.
Active Stop-and-Go Assist , is able to keep the vehicle within the lane and maintain a safe distance with a high level of availability at speeds up to 35 mph. With the extended restart function, the vehicle can restart automatically up to one minute after coming to a stop.
Active Steering Assist generates steering torque which helps the driver to stay in the center of the lane on straight roads and slight bends, taking its guidance from vehicles ahead and lane markings
with Active Emergency Stop Assist , which brakes the vehicle to a stop in a controlled manner when the system recognizes that the driver is distracted for a longer period or cannot intervene in vehicle control
and Active Lane Change Assist , which assists the driver in a convenient and cooperative manner when making lane changes.
Active Brake Assist with Cross-Traffic Function is able to help the driver avoid impending collisions with vehicles ahead or when turning off across the oncoming lane, the system will also assist with stationary or crossing vehicles and pedestrians, if the driver fails to take action quickly enough.
Active Speed Limit Assist with Traffic Sign Assist utilizes map data and information from Traffic Sign Assist to automatically adapt the vehicle's speed.
Active Blind Spot Assist is able to provide the driver with a visual alert, plus an audible alarm when a turn indicator is activated, to warn the driver if another vehicle is detected in the blind spot area. It can also help avoid a collision by single-sided braking if a lane change is still attempted with an obstacle in the blind spot.
with Exit Warning offers enhanced protection when getting out of the car, a visual warning for passengers displayed in the exterior mirror if a car or bicycle is driving past the vehicle. If the driver tries to open the door, an additional audible warning sound and ambient door lighting will start to flash red.
Active Lane Keeping Assist is able to warn the driver by means of vibrations of the steering wheel when the vehicle is unintentionally drifting out of its lane. If the vehicle passes over a solid line, or a dashed line when opposing traffic is detected, this system can pull the vehicle back into its lane by applying the brakes on one side.
Active Parking Assist with PARTRONIC and 360° camera make it possible to enter and leave parallel and end-on parking spaces or garages automatically.
PRE-SAFE® PLUS with PRE-SAFE® Sound activates the PRE-SAFE safety measures when a collision from behind is imminent as well as applying the brakes when the vehicle is at a standstill in order to prevent subsequent accidents. PRE-SAFE® Sound omits a short interference signal if an imminent collision is detected, triggering a protective reflex in the human ear referred to as the “stapedius reflex,” which can help reduce hearing loss in the event of an accident.
Model Positioning
With more than 14 million units delivered globally since 1946, the E-Class is the best-selling model series in the history of Mercedes-Benz. The tenth generation of the E-Class set styling trends in 2016 with its clean yet emotionally appealing design and exclusive high-quality interior. A wealth of innovations, such as the driving assistance systems, were also defining characteristics. With its recent redesign, the E-Class continues to set the benchmark for intelligence within the Mercedes- Benz lineup through top levels of comfort, luxury and safety.

with Augmented Video Navigation (available), when the navigation function is active, a video image of the surroundings is enhanced with arrows or house numbers automatically superimposed directly onto the image in the media display.

Active Distance Assist DISTRONIC® is an adaptive cruise control system that is able to automatically adjust your set speed for traffic ahead
with Route-Based Speed Adaptation, the vehicle is able to reduce the speed in anticipatory mode by referencing map data ahead of curves, junctions, roundabouts, toll booths and exit roads.
with LiveTraffic and End-of-Traffic-Jam Assist, the vehicle can recognize and respond to traffic jams and slow-moving traffic even before the driver becomes aware of them. Once traffic is detected, the speed is reduced to approx. 60 mph as a precaution unless the driver decides otherwise.
Active Stop-and-Go Assist , is able to keep the vehicle within the lane and maintain a safe distance with a high level of availability at speeds up to 35 mph. With the extended restart function, the vehicle can restart automatically up to one minute after coming to a stop.

with Active Emergency Stop Assist , which brakes the vehicle to a stop in a controlled manner when the system recognizes that the driver is distracted for a longer period or cannot intervene in vehicle control
and Active Lane Change Assist , which assists the driver in a convenient and cooperative manner when making lane changes.

With Exit Warning offers enhanced protection when getting out of the car, a visual warning for passengers displayed in the exterior mirror if a car or bicycle is driving past the vehicle. Active Lane Keeping Assist is able to warn the driver by means of vibrations of the steering wheel when the vehicle is unintentionally drifting out of its lane. Technical Feature Highlights
New Generation MBUX (Standard): The latest generation MBUX infotainment is even more intelligent and capable of learning.
Electronic Architecture : A more software- and less hardware-driven approach, the computing functions of previously separate domains take place in a single processor. Screens and the MBUX infotainment system share a new, powerful central onboard computer. This form of networking improves the performance, as data streams can be transmitted significantly faster.
Third-Party Apps : A new compatibility layer allows the installation of third-party apps, including the entertainment platform TikTok, the game Angry Birds, the collaborative app Webex and the video conferencing app Zoom.
Routines : Mercedes-Benz is pursuing the use of artificial intelligence (AI) to enable the car to learn which comfort systems occupants use repeatedly. Given the same circumstances, the aim is for AI to automate such functions, which Mercedes-Benz calls 'routines.' At launch of the new E-Class, customers will be able to use templates for standard routines as well as have the option of creating routines themselves by linking several functions and conditions.
Active Ambient Lighting with Sound Visualization (optional): The active light strip at the top of the instrument panel and in the front door panels can be used to produce a visual interpretation of any content from any source of entertainment sound. Software analyzes the audio signals based on frequency (bass/mid-tones/treble tones) and direction (right/left). Depending on the preferred color selected, the bass, mid tones and high tones are visualized in coordinated color tones and levels of brightness.
Augmented Video for Navigation (standard): When the navigation function is active, a video image of the surroundings is enhanced with arrows or house numbers automatically superimposed directly onto the image in the media display.
3D Driver Display (optional): This technology allows spatial scene perception with a real depth effect. The system uses autostereoscopy for the 3D effect. The LCD display combines a special pixel structure with a controllable LCD aperture grill. The result is that the left and right eye see different pixels of the LCD, creating the illusion of depth.
DIGITAL LIGHT (optional): HD system (more than 1 million pixels per headlamp) uses data from the camera, sensors and the navigation system to calculate the brightness value for each individual pixel in near real time.
48-Volt Mild Hybrid System (standard): The engines in the new E-Class feature intelligent support from an Integrated Starter Generator (ISG). This integrated electric motor system assists the combustion engine with up to 23 hp and 151 lb-ft of torque at lower engine speeds. The ISG also makes gliding possible and supplies the battery with power by means of high-efficiency recuperation. By doing so, it makes fuel savings possible that were previously the exclusive domain of high-voltage hybrid technology.
AIRMATIC (optional): AIRMATIC suspension with air springs and adaptive ADS+ dampers responds very sensitively. The damping characteristics are automatically controlled for each individual wheel, and separately during rebound and compression. While driving, a sophisticated sensor system and algorithms set the dampers according to the quality of the road.
Level Control : This feature keeps the ground clearance constant irrespective of the vehicle load, but also makes changes when needed. To reduce air resistance and thus fuel consumption, the vehicle level is automatically lowered by 0.6 inches from a speed of 74 mph in the COMFORT driving mode. At the same time the vehicle's center of gravity is lowered, which improves driving stability.
Rear-Axle Steering : At speeds below 37 mph, the rear wheels steer in the opposite direction to the front wheels – and by up to 4.5° against the front steering angle when parking. At speeds above 37 mph, the rear wheels steer up to 2.5° in the same direction as the front wheels.
Model Positioning
For over 75 years, the Mercedes-Benz E-Class has set the standard for the midsize luxury sedan segment. The new E-Class opens a new chapter for the model series, combining tradition with modernity. The all-new model showcases classic sedan proportions with elegant, modern exterior and interior design, innovative new technology and expansive comfort features.
